converted.description: What they were owed that was converted to shares in the year, effective when ACRA registered it (FR-EQ-06).

deferred_pay.description: What the company owes them on 2120 Deferred remuneration payable at the day: pay and fees not yet paid.

fees_for_year.description: Directors' fees owed to them in the financial year to the day (FR-EQ-04).

loan.description: What the company owes them on 2500 Loan from director / shareholder at the day: positive owed to them; negative means they owe the company, shown under 1250 Staff & director advances (FR-EQ-11).

waived.description: What they waived of what they were owed in the year (FR-EQ-07).
